Morning deaths eliminate day workers and students, leaving night workers + at-home people (35%, base pool 35000). Only two source kinds used, so capture is impossible during this probe. Day 1 selected d1-1,d1-2,d1-5,d1-8,d1-10. Repeat wire/forum/national on days 2–3, then interpret day-3 press conference. Ideal rounded pools: 40000 neither source learned; 7000 wire accessible; 9000 forum accessible; 2000 both accessible. Cross-post disjunctions and unsuccessful/missed traces can leave larger/intermediate pools, so inference is probabilistic. Pool 7000 strongly establishes wire accessible; 2000 establishes both. Pool 9000 usually means forum accessible, though rare wire-only cross-post evidence can mimic this. Once an accessible kind is identified, permanently avoid it and take the other 9/day; quick morning entries suffice. Initial 5/day for 3 days followed by 9/day reaches double on day 5 and quadruple on day 7, approximately 924 total points if inference succeeds immediately. Avoid indiscriminate 11/day: learning all three accessible kinds after routine elimination causes capture and halves points.
